title: VACCINATION CERTIFICATE REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERNATIONAL TRAVEL = CERTIFICATS DE VACCINATION EXIGÉS DANS LES VOYACES INTERNATIONAUX

sections.title: Page 1

summary.text: A bilingual amendment to the 1971 vaccination certificate requirements for international travel, adding cholera certificate requirements for Greece and Ireland and revising Saudi Arabia's cholera rule for a 1971 period. The scanned text contains OCR errors.
